messages.text:
They were looking at the Treasury 12" convertible globe, which can be set up either way — so floor standing with that one is no problem at all. If you'd like something built specifically as a statement floor piece, though, our top pick there is the Annapolis 20-inch Illuminated Antique Floor Globe: it's a large hand-assembled heirloom globe with a raised relief antique map that glows when lit, on a handcrafted hardwood stand, and shipping is free on it.

Would you like to stick with the Treasury in its floor configuration, or go bigger with the Annapolis?

viewed: Treasury 12" Antique Ocean Convertible Floor and Tabletop Globe
